title: WebText
authors: A. Radford, J. Wu, R. Child, D. Luan, D. Amodei, I. Sutskever
before: Language models trained on curated corpora like Wikipedia and books.
problem: Curated text is small; raw web crawl is enormous but mostly junk.
breakthrough: Use human curation as a quality signal: scrape only pages linked from Reddit posts above a karma threshold.
why: It introduced proxy-based quality filtering, the ancestor of every data pipeline from C4 to FineWeb.
next: C4, the Pile, RefinedWeb and FineWeb all refined the filtering problem.
inherits: The idea that data quality filtering is a first-class part of training.
